llm.summary: The skill is coherent for PandaDoc automation, but its first-time setup tells users to execute an unverified remote installer, which deserves review before installation.

dimensions.detail: The declared tool access is limited to Bash(oo *), credentials are described as server-side injected, and write/destructive PandaDoc actions are labeled with confirmation requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes pipe-to-shell commands for macOS/Linux and Windows without pinning, checksum verification, signature verification, or an explicit approval step before local installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad for any PandaDoc request, but the operational instructions are scoped to the pandadoc connector and require schema inspection before action payloads are built.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No bundled persistence, background worker, memory modification, or privilege escalation behavior was found, but installing the oo CLI is a local system change whose installed paths and rollback behavior are not described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is purpose-aligned with PandaDoc operations through the OOMOL oo CLI and clearly lists read, write, and destructive PandaDoc actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. It is suitable for PandaDoc connector workflows, but avoid running the documented remote installer commands as written unless you independently trust the OOMOL CLI installer source; prefer a signed, versioned, or checksum-verified installation path. Confirm all write and destructive PandaDoc actions before execution.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: Confirmed in SKILL.md: the CLI install fallback uses curl piped to bash and PowerShell irm piped to iex. Installing a connector CLI fits the skill purpose, but direct remote execution without integrity checks is under-controlled.
[SQP-1] expected: Confirmed broad activation wording for PandaDoc requests. This is broad but still tied to the named service and mitigated by connector-only instructions plus confirmation requirements for write and destructive actions.
[T03] unexpected: The static scan's remote execution concern is supported by the same first-time setup commands; this is a supply-chain and local-execution risk, not evidence of malicious payloads in the artifact.
